name: habitude-checklist
description: 7-day habit checklist with streaks and weekly review for Obsidian

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:coach && npm run test:edge && npm run test:settings && npm run test:checkmark && npm run test:migration && npm run test:share && npm run test:i18n && npm run test:providers
scripts.test:cloud: esbuild test/cloud/cloud-test.ts --bundle --platform=node --alias:obsidian=./test/stress/mock-obsidian.ts --outfile=test/cloud/dist/cloud-test.cjs --format=cjs --log-level=warning && node test/cloud/dist/cloud-test.cjs && esbuild test/cloud/load-probe.ts --bundle --platform=node --alias:obsidian=./test/stress/mock-obsidian.ts --alias:firebase/app=./test/cloud/mock-firebase-app.ts --alias:firebase/auth=./test/cloud/mock-firebase-auth.ts --alias:firebase/firestore=./test/cloud/mock-firebase-firestore.ts --outfile=test/cloud/dist/load-probe.cjs --format=cjs --log-level=warning && node test/cloud/dist/load-probe.cjs && esbuild test/cloud/lazy-probe.ts --bundle --platform=node --alias:firebase/app=./test/cloud/mock-firebase-app.ts --alias:firebase/auth=./test/cloud/mock-firebase-auth.ts --alias:firebase/firestore=./test/cloud/mock-firebase-firestore.ts --outfile=test/cloud/dist/lazy-probe.cjs --format=cjs --log-level=warning && node test/cloud/dist/lazy-probe.cjs && npm run test:mocke2e
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:cloud
